scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences)
Noted the two target frameworks (net10.0 and net472)
Observed errors concentrated in new HotReload test files

scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, recovered well from path and output-size issues, and delivered accurate core diagnosis (failure, scale, codes, real failing projects). Missed the root-cause file-level insight (HotReload tests) and ended on an awkward non-answer final message.
